text_block_list.text:
On the way to the trainer's office, I 
spotted Daitaku Helios talking with 
friends in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
âAh, by the way, Helio, you haven't 
replied to yesterday's LANE. What's the 
play? Should I go ahead with it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Did I leave you on read? For real? 
Ah, so sorry! Hold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're totally leaving me on read. Pien~~~

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you've had races back-to-back 
lately, right? Means you're really going 
all out, so don't sweat it~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't my besties seriously the sweetest 
ever? I'm totally gonna cry, hugs and 
peace~!"

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? C'mon, don't pounce on me like 
that~ Good boy, good boy.

It seems Daitaku Helios is accumulating 
fatigue from the races... We might need to 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
